findings.ac: AC3 demoable end-to-end (DRY_RUN=true node scripts/run-job-ingestion.js shows Infinite Roots via personio)
findings.text: No test, script change or doc proves the dry-run demo: BT200_EmbeddedAtsRouting.test.js drives FallbackEngine.extractJobs with a mock company and mocked fetch only, never scripts/run-job-ingestion.js, and the only routing evidence is the console.log 'Detected embedded ATS (personio)' in fallbackEngine.js; runtime-only and unverified.

findings.ac: AC2 robots-disallowed / TDM-reserved page with an embed is skipped with no adapter call
findings.text: The robots test uses a mockRobotsGuard that rejects before any page is fetched, so no embed page is involved (only fetchSpy not called); the TDM test has an iframe embed but never spies on or asserts that no adapter/personio request happened (the IngestionSkipError rejection is the only assertion).

findings.ac: AC5 Stress: multiple embeds on one page -> first by provider order, logged
findings.text: Provider-order is tested (personio before greenhouse in detectEmbeddedAts) but the 'logged' requirement is not met or asserted: fallbackEngine.js logs only the single chosen embed (console.log 'Detected embedded ATS'), with no note of other embeds seen, and no test spies on console.
